title: 冷氣歹去 Líng-khì Pháinn--khì
mood: the two hot weeks you were closest
subject: the summer the air conditioner broke and two people slept on the floor for two weeks
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien contemporary R&B in slow-jam form. Lush layered synth pads, finger snaps instead of a snare, a slow programmed drum machine groove, a warm sustained sub bass, a soft electric piano filling between lines. Lush, slow and intimate with a warm low end and a close, dry vocal. Male voice singing slow-jam R&B phrasing that rises into falsetto on the chorus, smooth and tender, without any traditional ballad ornament or enka-style weeping. 76 BPM, A flat major. The two hot weeks when you were closest. No country guitar, no funk horns, no acoustic instruments, no autotune, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
七月 冷氣歹去 師傅講 愛等兩禮拜
三十六度 阮兩个 睏佇塗跤
電風吹甲 攏是燒風 汗流甲規身軀
你講「好熱」 阮講「好熱」 阮兩个 煞笑出來

[Chorus]
冷氣歹去的熱天
阮 無法度 離甲傷遠
熱甲欲死 嘛是黏做伙
彼兩禮拜 阮上親

[Verse]
冷氣修好矣 房間冷甲欲寒
阮各人睏一爿 棉被蓋甲懸懸
你越頭過去 阮越頭過來
房間傷冷 冷甲阮 煞想起彼兩禮拜

[Chorus]
冷氣歹去的熱天
阮 無法度 離甲傷遠
熱甲欲死 嘛是黏做伙
今仔暗 阮共冷氣關掉

[Outro]
窗仔開開
風入來
